AuthLevel.description: How strongly the session's subject is authenticated, from weakest to strongest.
AuthLevel.title: AuthLevel

BalanceView.description: One product's balance. ``product_ref`` is grounding evidence; the chat shows only the masked number.
BalanceView.title: BalanceView

CardActionConfirmation.description: What the customer confirms before a card write. Only self-service card actions have one.
CardActionConfirmation.title: CardActionConfirmation

CardRequest.description: The card request a handoff carries: what the customer asked for, and for which card.
CardRequest.title: CardRequest

CardStatusView.description: A card's status as shown to its owner. ``product_ref`` is grounding evidence, never displayed.
CardStatusView.title: CardStatusView

ChallengeResponse.description: An open one-time-code challenge. ``demo_code`` is set only when demo mode is on, labeled as a demo.
ChallengeResponse.title: ChallengeResponse

Channel.description: The service channel a conversation runs on (not the channel of a transaction).
Channel.title: Channel

ClarificationOption.description: One candidate transaction, shown masked. The option id is opaque; the transaction id stays server side.
ClarificationOption.title: ClarificationOption

CreditApplicationView.description: An intake recorded for human review. It is never a lending decision; the policy behind it is synthetic.
CreditApplicationView.title: CreditApplicationView

CreditIntakeConfirmation.description:
What the customer confirms before an application intake is recorded for human review.

It shows no declared income, and states that the result is indicative, not an offer or a decision.
CreditIntakeConfirmation.title: CreditIntakeConfirmation

CreditProduct.description:
A catalog entry as a message part: the domain ``CreditProduct`` plus ``display_name``, the catalog's name in
the message's language (``None`` for a code the catalog cannot name). Indicative ranges only: never an offer.

It keeps the domain name so the OpenAPI component stays ``CreditProduct``.
CreditProduct.title: CreditProduct

CreditReview.description: The credit part of a handoff: what was assessed, why a human is needed, and the internal estimate.
CreditReview.title: CreditReview

CreditReviewRisk.description: The estimate a human reviewer sees in a handoff. Agents see it; customers never do.
CreditReviewRisk.title: CreditReviewRisk

CsrfResponse.description: The double-submit token, also set as the readable CSRF cookie. Send it in ``X-CSRF-Token``.
CsrfResponse.title: CsrfResponse

CurrencyTotals.description: Settled debits and credits in one currency. Amounts in different currencies are never added together.
CurrencyTotals.title: CurrencyTotals

DateRange.description: An inclusive range of calendar dates in the customer's time zone.
DateRange.title: DateRange

DocumentLogin.description: A document number plus the last four phone digits. Never proof of identity: it only opens a challenge.
DocumentLogin.title: DocumentLogin

EligibilityAssessmentRecord.description: An eligibility assessment as the execution record keeps it: rule ids and versions, not parameters.
EligibilityAssessmentRecord.title: EligibilityAssessmentRecord

EligibilityOutcome.description: There is no approved outcome by design: the synthetic service gives an indication, never a decision.
EligibilityOutcome.title: EligibilityOutcome

EligibilityView.description: The customer-facing part of an assessment. It never carries the estimate or any profile value.
EligibilityView.title: EligibilityView

EvaluationSummariesResponse.description: Newest first. Empty until the evaluation harness publishes a run.
EvaluationSummariesResponse.title: EvaluationSummariesResponse

Intent.description:
What the customer wants. Each intent is owned by exactly one workflow or is cross-workflow.

``domain.workflow_catalog.WORKFLOW_CATALOG`` assigns the owners; ``CROSS_WORKFLOW_INTENTS`` lists the rest.
Intent.title: Intent

LanguageDetection.description: ``language`` is ``None`` when the detector is uncertain; the engine then asks the customer.
LanguageDetection.title: LanguageDetection

MaskedNumber.description: The last four alphanumeric characters of a product number, rendered as ``**** 1234``.
MaskedNumber.title: MaskedNumber

MetricCount.description: A count and the denominator it is reported over.
MetricCount.title: MetricCount

Money.description: An amount in one currency. JSON form: ``{"amount": "12.50", "currency": "MXN"}``.
Money.title: Money

OutcomeMetrics.description: The brief's outcome definitions over one slice of the workload.
OutcomeMetrics.title: OutcomeMetrics

PaymentStatusView.description: The status of one payment or transfer. ``payee_display`` is sanitized record text, never an instruction.
PaymentStatusView.title: PaymentStatusView

ProblemDetails.description: RFC 9457 problem details. `type` is a stable URI per error; `errors` lists invalid fields.
ProblemDetails.title: ProblemDetails

RetrievalRecord.description: What open retrieval did for an informational turn: which retriever, against which threshold, with what.
RetrievalRecord.title: RetrievalRecord

RiskEstimateRecord.description: A risk estimate as the execution record keeps it (glass box, phase 13). Internal.
RiskEstimateRecord.title: RiskEstimateRecord

RiskEstimateUsed.description: That a risk estimate was used, and which model made it. No value of the estimate.
RiskEstimateUsed.title: RiskEstimateUsed

RuleResult.description: The outcome of one rule. A failed rule names the effect it asks the evaluator to apply.
RuleResult.title: RuleResult

SendTurnRequest.description: One customer message. ``turn_id`` is a client-made UUID; sending the same one again replays the result.
SendTurnRequest.title: SendTurnRequest

SignedInResponse.description: A new session: the session cookie is set, and ``csrf_token`` is the rotated double-submit token.
SignedInResponse.title: SignedInResponse

SliceSummary.description:
The outcome metrics for one slice, for example ``language`` ``pt`` or ``segment`` ``premium`` (added in 1.1.0).

``workflow`` is ``None`` for a slice across every workflow.
SliceSummary.title: SliceSummary

SourceTable.description: Tables a verified fact or an evidence reference may point to.
SourceTable.title: SourceTable

StaffTraceRecord.description: The evaluator view: everything in the record, the internal risk estimates included.
StaffTraceRecord.title: StaffTraceRecord

StatementSummary.description:
A summary of one product's transactions in a period.

``totals`` cover approved transactions whose direction is known, one entry per currency.
``unclassified_count`` counts approved transfers and adjustments; ``not_settled_count`` counts pending,
declined, and reversed transactions. At most ``MAX_STATEMENT_LINES`` lines are listed, newest first.
StatementSummary.title: StatementSummary

ToolName.description:
Every banking tool (phase 05).

Three are writes and share their value with an ``ActionKind``: ``create_dispute_case``, ``block_card``, and
``submit_credit_application``. Every other tool reads. ``get_product_status`` also serves card status, and
``list_my_cards`` lists the customer's cards so the card workflow can offer a masked choice, and
``list_my_credit_applications`` lists their credit application intakes so a status question needs no id. The
risk estimator and the eligibility service are not tools: the engine calls them, and no model output can
select them.
ToolName.title: ToolName

TurnResponse.description: The result of one turn: the assistant message and where the conversation now is.

workflow.description: The workflow after the turn; the router is `router@1`.

TurnResponse.title: TurnResponse

Verification.description: The result of reading back an action's effect.
Verification.title: Verification

VerifiedFact.description: A fact the system verified, with the record that proves it (``table:id``).
VerifiedFact.title: VerifiedFact

WorkflowId.description:
The supported workflows (section 1 of CLAUDE.md). ``WorkflowRef.id`` stays a pattern-constrained string in
every contract; membership in this registry is checked by the application, not by the schemas.
WorkflowId.title: WorkflowId

WorkflowRef.description: Which workflow definition, and which version of it, handled a turn.
WorkflowRef.title: WorkflowRef

csrfHeader.description: The double-submit token from `GET /v1/auth/csrf`, echoed on every state-changing request.
csrfHeader.name: X-CSRF-Token

sessionCookie.description: Opaque session token (HttpOnly). The development cookie is named `session`.
sessionCookie.name: __Host-session

get.description: The process is up and serving requests.
Every configured dependency is reachable. Failures report the check name only, never error text.

Reviewable intakes (submitted, under human review) and any a handoff references, newest first.

Read only, and never a lending decision.
The inbox, soonest SLA first, filtered by workflow, priority, reason, language, status, and SLA due.

post.description: Claim an open handoff for the signed-in agent.
Resolve a handoff this agent claimed, with an outcome code and a note.

get.description: A double-submit token bound to the current session cookie, or anonymous before login.

post.description: Revoke the session (when there is one), clear the cookie, and return an anonymous CSRF token.

get.description: The session's role, authentication level, expiry instants, and language preference.

post.description: Open a one-time-code challenge. Unknown people get an indistinguishable challenge that never succeeds.
Open a step-up challenge bound to this session (needed before a write action).
Verify the step-up code; the session rotates (new token, same lineage) and a step-up window opens.
Verify the code and start a session; any previous session of this browser is revoked.
Open an empty conversation for the signed-in customer.

get.description: The conversation and its turns, oldest first.
The execution records of the customer's own conversation (glass box), without risk estimate values.

post.description: Send one customer message and get the assistant's reply with every workflow part.

get.description: Every execution record of any conversation, with the internal risk estimates.
Published evaluation summaries, newest first; empty until the harness publishes a run.
